groups.name: Calculus Problem Solvers
groups.subject: Calculus
groups.description: A peer-learning space for limits, continuity, differentiation, integration, applications of derivatives, multiple integrals and differential equations. Share worked solutions, compare methods and run short weekly problem-solving sessions.

groups.name: Linear Algebra Study Circle
groups.subject: Linear Algebra
groups.description: Practice matrices, determinants, rank, systems of equations, vector spaces, linear independence, eigenvalues, eigenvectors and diagonalization. Members can take turns explaining problems and checking solutions.

groups.name: Discrete Mathematics Circle
groups.subject: Discrete Mathematics
groups.timing: Flexible weekly logic and graph sessions
groups.description: Learn propositional logic, proof techniques, sets, relations, functions, combinatorics, recurrence relations, number theory and graph theory through examples, puzzles and peer discussion.

groups.name: Probability & Statistics Lab
groups.subject: Probability & Statistics
groups.description: Work through probability rules, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, random variables, distributions, expectation, variance, confidence intervals and hypothesis testing using small datasets.

groups.name: DSA Daily Practice Group
groups.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
groups.timing: Flexible coding practice and peer reviews
groups.description: Solve problems on arrays, strings, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, hashing, graphs, sorting and searching. Share approaches, discuss complexity and review clean code in C, C++ or Java.

groups.name: DAA Algorithm Design Workshop
groups.subject: Design and Analysis of Algorithms (DAA)
groups.description: Study divide and conquer, recurrences, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, backtracking, graph algorithms, MST, shortest paths and complexity analysis. Present pseudocode and compare alternative solutions.

groups.name: Java OOP & Backend Builders
groups.subject: Java Programming
groups.timing: Flexible Java lab and code-review sessions
groups.description: Practice classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, exceptions, collections, generics, file I/O, multithreading, JDBC and Spring Boot basics. Build small Java programs and review each other's code.

groups.name: Python Practice & Automation
groups.subject: Python Programming
groups.description: Learn Python fundamentals, functions, collections, file handling, OOP, exceptions, modules, generators, data analysis and automation. Complete bite-sized exercises and mini-projects together.

groups.name: DBMS & SQL Query Clinic
groups.subject: Database Management Systems (DBMS)
groups.description: Practice ER modelling, keys, normalization, SQL joins, subqueries, views, indexes, transactions, ACID properties and query optimization with practical database exercises.

groups.name: Operating Systems Study Hub
groups.subject: Operating Systems
groups.description: Discuss processes, threads, CPU scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks, memory management, paging, virtual memory and file systems. Solve numerical problems and trace algorithms step by step.

groups.name: Computer Networks Lab Circle
groups.subject: Computer Networks
groups.description: Study OSI and TCP/IP models, IP addressing, subnetting, routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP, error detection and network security. Practice packet-flow explanations and small socket-programming exercises.

groups.name: Computer Architecture Workshop
groups.subject: Computer Organization & Architecture
groups.description: Explore number systems, Boolean logic, instruction cycles, CPU datapaths, pipelining, cache memory, memory hierarchy, addressing modes, interrupts and I/O. Work through architecture numericals and diagrams.

groups.name: Placement Preparation Squad
groups.subject: Placement Preparation
groups.timing: Weekly aptitude, coding and progress check-ins
groups.description: A combined placement-preparation group covering quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability, DSA practice, resume checkpoints and company-style mock tests. Members set weekly goals and track progress.

groups.name: Technical Interview Practice Room
groups.subject: Technical Interviews
groups.timing: Peer mock interviews by weekly slots
groups.description: Practice explaining DSA, OOP, DBMS, operating systems, computer networks, Java and project decisions. Take turns as interviewer and candidate, then exchange structured feedback.

groups.name: Resume & LinkedIn Review Circle
groups.subject: Career Development
groups.description: Improve one-page resumes, project descriptions, GitHub profiles and LinkedIn summaries. Focus on clear impact statements, readable formatting, honest skill claims and role-specific customization.

groups.name: System Design & Projects Circle
groups.subject: System Design
groups.description: Build confidence in requirements gathering, API design, database schema design, caching, scalability, reliability and trade-offs. Start with small campus applications and progress to interview-style case studies.

projects.title: Calculus Visualizer & Graph Explorer
projects.description: Build an interactive learning tool that plots user-entered functions and illustrates limits, derivatives, tangent lines, definite integrals and area-under-curve approximations. Include worked examples and a quiz mode so students can compare numerical and analytical results.
projects.requiredSkills: Python, JavaScript, React, calculus, data visualization
projects.rolesNeeded: Frontend Developer, Python Developer, Mathematics Content Designer, Tester

projects.title: Linear Algebra & Matrix Toolkit
projects.description: Create a web toolkit for matrix operations, determinant, inverse, rank, row-reduction, solving linear systems and visualizing 2D/3D vectors. Add step-by-step explanations and small demonstrations of eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
projects.requiredSkills: Python, NumPy, JavaScript, linear algebra, UI development
projects.rolesNeeded: Frontend Developer, Python Developer, Mathematics Developer, QA Tester

projects.title: Discrete Math Logic and Graph Simulator
projects.description: Develop an educational simulator for truth tables, logical equivalences, relations, set operations, graph traversal, shortest paths and spanning trees. Let learners create small graphs and observe algorithm steps.
projects.requiredSkills: JavaScript, React, graph algorithms, discrete mathematics
projects.rolesNeeded: Frontend Developer, Algorithms Developer, UI Designer, Tester

projects.title: Student Performance Statistics Dashboard
projects.description: Create a dashboard that analyzes sample or consented academic data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, correlation and visualizations. Clearly separate correlation from causation and avoid making high-stakes predictions about students.
projects.requiredSkills: Python, Pandas, statistics, SQL, data visualization
projects.rolesNeeded: Data Analyst, Python Developer, Backend Developer, UI Developer

projects.title: DSA Algorithm Visualizer
projects.description: Build a visual playground for arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, hashing, sorting, searching, BFS and DFS. Show operations one step at a time and display time and space complexity with examples.
projects.requiredSkills: C++ or Java, data structures, algorithms, JavaScript, React
projects.rolesNeeded: Algorithms Developer, Frontend Developer, Content Writer, Tester

projects.title: Algorithm Benchmark & Complexity Lab
projects.description: Create a platform to run selected sorting, searching, graph and dynamic-programming algorithms on generated inputs. Compare runtime and operation counts, explain best/average/worst cases and export experiment results.
projects.requiredSkills: Java or C++, DAA, benchmarking, Python, charts
projects.rolesNeeded: Algorithms Developer, Backend Developer, Data Visualization Developer, Tester

projects.title: Java Campus Service Management System
projects.description: Develop a Java application for managing campus service requests such as maintenance, classroom equipment and facility issues. Include OOP design, role-based access, validation, exception handling, database persistence and status tracking.
projects.requiredSkills: Java, OOP, JDBC or Spring Boot, SQL, Git
projects.rolesNeeded: Java Backend Developer, Database Developer, Frontend Developer, QA Tester

projects.title: Python Campus Automation Suite
projects.description: Build a set of useful Python utilities for organizing study schedules, processing CSV files, generating simple reports, validating input files and sending configurable reminders. Include tests, documentation and a command-line interface.
projects.requiredSkills: Python, file handling, OOP, automation, testing
projects.rolesNeeded: Python Developer, Automation Tester, Documentation Lead

projects.title: Course Registration & Timetable Database
projects.description: Design a relational database for courses, instructors, rooms, student enrollments and timetable slots. Implement normalization, constraints, transactions, conflict checks, SQL reports and a simple application interface.
projects.requiredSkills: DBMS, SQL, database design, Java or Python, backend development
projects.rolesNeeded: Database Designer, Backend Developer, Frontend Developer, QA Tester

projects.title: Operating System Scheduling Simulator
projects.description: Create a simulator for FCFS, SJF, Priority and Round Robin scheduling. Allow users to enter process arrival and burst times, then visualize Gantt charts, waiting time, turnaround time and comparisons.
projects.requiredSkills: C or Java, operating systems, algorithms, charts
projects.rolesNeeded: Systems Programmer, Algorithms Developer, UI Developer, Tester

projects.title: Computer Networks Packet Journey Explorer
projects.description: Build a learning tool that explains how a packet moves through a small simulated network. Include IP addressing, subnet calculations, routing tables, TCP/UDP comparisons and basic client-server socket demonstrations.
projects.requiredSkills: Computer networks, Python or Java, socket programming, networking fundamentals
projects.rolesNeeded: Networking Developer, Backend Developer, UI Developer, Technical Writer

projects.title: Cache & CPU Pipeline Simulator
projects.description: Develop an educational simulator for cache mapping, hit/miss behavior, memory hierarchy and a simple instruction pipeline. Show how different cache sizes or pipeline hazards affect execution metrics.
projects.requiredSkills: C or C++, computer architecture, digital logic, algorithms
projects.rolesNeeded: Systems Developer, Simulator Developer, UI Developer, Tester

projects.title: Placement Readiness Tracker
projects.description: Create a student dashboard to track aptitude practice, DSA progress, mock-test scores, resume reviews, target roles and interview preparation milestones. Use transparent progress metrics and let students control their own data.
projects.requiredSkills: React, Java or Spring Boot, SQL, REST APIs, charts
projects.rolesNeeded: Frontend Developer, Backend Developer, Database Developer, UI/UX Designer

projects.title: Resume & Job Description Matcher
projects.description: Build a resume helper that compares a student's resume text with a job description, highlights relevant skills and suggests clearer project bullets. Keep suggestions explainable and remind users to verify every claim; do not invent experience or guarantee ATS results.
projects.requiredSkills: Python, NLP basics, React, Java or Python backend, text processing
projects.rolesNeeded: NLP Developer, Backend Developer, Frontend Developer, UX Writer

projects.title: Technical Mock Interview Platform
projects.description: Develop a platform for scheduling peer mock interviews, selecting topics, sharing coding prompts, recording structured feedback and tracking improvement over time. Include question banks for DSA, Java, DBMS, OS and networks.
projects.requiredSkills: React, Spring Boot, SQL, WebSockets, DSA, UI design
projects.rolesNeeded: Frontend Developer, Backend Developer, Database Developer, QA Tester

projects.title: Campus Opportunity & Skill Matcher
projects.description: Build a student-controlled portal that matches internship or project opportunities with declared skills, interests and availability. Show why a match was suggested and allow users to update or remove profile information.
projects.requiredSkills: Java, Spring Boot, SQL, React, recommendation basics
projects.rolesNeeded: Backend Developer, Frontend Developer, Recommendation Developer, Tester
